about: One word list for every generated page. The Python check (src/methanewatch/report/lint.py) and the website build both read this file and fail a build on a hit. Edit it here only, never in one side's code. Patterns are regular expressions that work the same in Python and JavaScript, matched case-insensitively.

saved.note: Nothing is saved unless a drop was verified. Allowed only on a verified-drop page.

real-time.note: This is a retrospective tracker; sources publish about 30 days after observation.

violation.note: Results are screening indications, never compliance findings.

non-compliant.note: Results are screening indications, never compliance findings.

illegal.note: Results are screening indications, never compliance findings.

health impact.note: No health claims. Residents nearby are context only.

quoted_source_title.note: An official document's title (for example the formal name of a notice) may contain a banned word. It may appear only inside an element marked data-wording="source-title", or in the source_doc_title field of a record. Both checks skip exactly that and nothing else.
